change: Capacity and composition first; full-width main cards with natural height; compact responsive status cards; aligned category rows; measured full-width trend; latest compaction, request usage, automatic read-only stored-summary preview, full-width seven-field reader, timeline and content browsing. No compaction policy, budget, saved-setting or Host ownership change.
reviewFixes: Sparkline uses the 40-unit viewBox consistently, draws a path per contiguous segment and never connects across a missing projection.

The summary preview loads the newest applied checkpoint once on mount; the request is aborted and ignored when the session or checkpoint identity changes, while cut polling keeps the same stored summary visible. Constraints render as a list.

Capacity composition reuses composition(data, policy) verbatim: no output-reserve or safety recomputation, no zero for an unknown admission split. Unknown free/reserve values keep explicit gray legend entries (including an unresolved window) instead of a fabricated ratio.

Reduction direction is uniform: positive delta reads as reduced with a minus sign, negative as increased with a plus sign, zero as unchanged, and a newest applied entry without before/after values stays unknown instead of borrowing an older figure.
Session cost reads are keyed by target and refresh after new requests; a historical cut or target switch never shows another session's cost, and a partial cost is labelled as a lower bound.
The trend has readable y-axis ticks, keeps an over-window peak above the 100% line, breaks area fill at missing ranges, and trend points answer Enter/Space for historical navigation.

Request usage uses aligned horizontal stacks. Segments explicitly override the global 6px legend-dot size; real zero segments are omitted, fully unknown samples show unknown, and partially reported samples show a lower bound.
